mapper.select: SELECT recovery_id, direction, source_record_id, business_intent_key, state, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, last_error_code, last_error_summary, dead_lettered_at, recovery_required_at, replay_count, last_replayed_at, last_replayed_by_type, last_replayed_by_id, last_replay_reason, last_replay_correlation_id, resolved_at, lock_version, created_at, updated_at FROM message_recovery WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND recovery_id = #{recoveryId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id, inbox_id, producer_service, message_id, business_intent_key, contract_ref, contract_version, body_bytes, body_sha256, correlation_id, causation_id, occurred_at, status, lock_version FROM inbox_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND inbox_id = #{inboxId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT outbox_id,contract_ref,contract_version,correlation_id,status,lock_version FROM outbox_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT audit_id, action_code, target_type, target_id, outcome, actor_type, actor_id, reason, error_code, correlation_id, causation_id FROM audit_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND audit_id = #{auditId}
mapper.update: UPDATE message_recovery SET state = 'REPLAYING', next_attempt_at = #{leaseUntil}, replay_count = replay_count + 1, last_replayed_at = #{now}, last_replayed_by_type = 'USER', last_replayed_by_id = #{actorId}, last_replay_reason = #{reason}, last_replay_correlation_id = #{attemptCorrelationId}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by_type = 'USER', updated_by_id = #{actorId} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND recovery_id = #{recoveryRecoveryId} AND direction = 'INBOX' AND source_record_id = #{recoverySourceRecordId} AND state = 'OPEN' AND lock_version = #{recoveryLockVersion}

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='REPLAYING',next_attempt_at=NULL,replay_count=replay_count+1, last_replayed_at=#{now},last_replayed_by_type='USER',last_replayed_by_id=#{actorId}, last_replay_reason=#{reason},last_replay_correlation_id=#{attemptCorrelationId}, lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='USER',updated_by_id=#{actorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recovery_id=#{recoveryRecoveryId} AND direction='OUTBOX' AND source_record_id=#{sourceOutboxId} AND state='OPEN' AND lock_version=#{recoveryLockVersion}

UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PENDING',attempt_count=0,next_attempt_at=#{now},locked_by=NULL, locked_at=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,broker_confirmed_at=NULL, lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{sourceOutboxId} AND status='RECOVERY_REQUIRED' AND lock_version=#{sourceLockVersion}

UPDATE message_recovery SET state = 'OPEN', next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_summary = #{errorSummary}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by_type = 'SERVICE', updated_by_id = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND recovery_id = #{recoveryId} AND direction = 'INBOX' AND state = 'REPLAYING' AND last_replay_correlation_id = #{attemptCorrelationId} AND next_attempt_at = #{leaseUntil}

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='RESOLVED',next_attempt_at=NULL,resolved_at=#{now}, lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recovery_id=#{recoveryId} AND direction='INBOX' AND state='REPLAYING' AND last_replay_correlation_id=#{attemptCorrelationId} AND next_attempt_at=#{leaseUntil}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_record (tenant_id, audit_id, action_code, target_type, target_id, outcome, actor_type, actor_id, reason, error_code, correlation_id, causation_id, occurred_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{auditId}, #{action}, 'MESSAGE_RECOVERY', #{recoveryId}, #{outcome}, 'USER', #{actorId}, #{reason}, #{errorCode}, #{correlationId}, #{causationId}, #{now})
